name: Dev Environment
description: A complete local development environment managed from inside TEDI, on Windows, macOS and Linux. Downloads and manages its own PHP, Node.js, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Nginx, Apache and Composer, none of it shared with anything already on the machine. PHP and Node.js install side by side at any number of versions, and a project pins its own without touching the global default, so a terminal opened in that project resolves the runtime the project asked for. Virtual hosts are generated per project with a configurable suffix, HTTPS is issued from a local CA that is trusted once, hosts entries are written for you under a single elevation prompt, and ports are allocated around whatever is already listening. Scheduled jobs run on real cron expressions and resolve each job's runtime from the folder it runs in. Nothing is hardcoded: every version list, download URL and path is metadata resolved at runtime.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com

settings.label: Data directory
settings.description: Where runtimes, services, certificates and generated config live. Blank uses ~/.tedi/devenv. Moving this does not migrate an existing install.

settings.label: Default domain suffix
settings.description: Appended to a project name to form its local domain, e.g. "test" gives project-a.test. A project can override its own.

settings.label: Web server
settings.description: Which server serves the virtual hosts. Both can be installed, but only one runs at a time: starting the other one stops this one, and it takes the same ports.

settings.label: HTTP port
settings.description: Port 80 needs elevation on macOS and Linux. Any port above 1024 does not.

settings.label: Issue HTTPS certificates automatically
settings.description: Generates a local CA on first use and a certificate per domain. The CA is trusted once, per machine.

settings.label: Manage the hosts file
settings.description: Writes project domains into a delimited block in the system hosts file. Every change is applied under one elevation prompt.
